description: WITAN error match (off by default): when a shell command fails, show a published fix for its error. README.md says what is sent.

hooks.command: case "${WITAN_ERROR_MATCH:-}${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_OPTION_ERROR_MATCH:-}" in ''|false|0|off|no) exit 0 ;; esac; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/error-match.mjs"; exit 0
